content.title: As the EV Price War Heats Up in China, Can Nio Stock Survive 2026?
content.summary: Nio is like a speculative survivor rather than a clear winner for 2026, with subsidies, record deliveries, and improving margins offset by brutal price-war consolidation, persistent losses, and only about 10% implied upside from a cautious Hold‑rated analyst consensus.
